scenes.title: Airport Terminal
scenes.description: A 36 m departure concourse: check-in island, security lane, gate seating, duty-free kiosk, departure boards — travelers with roller bags criss-crossing, a jet at the glass.

scenes.title: Assembly Line
scenes.description: A 9 m belt conveyor carrying parts, workstations with bins on both sides and an operator slot for the robot.

scenes.title: Bedroom
scenes.description: Bedroom with quilted bed, nightstands, dresser, wardrobe and window; alarm clock on the nightstand.

scenes.title: Grand Boulevard
scenes.description: A 70 m four-lane boulevard with a planted median: a bus works its stop, cars overtake in both directions, pedestrians and a median promenade — the robot starts curbside by the bus shelter.

scenes.title: Brooklyn Bridge
scenes.description: On the Brooklyn Bridge promenade: the two Gothic stone towers with their pointed arches and the fan of cable stays, the wood walkway above the car deck, the East River below and the Manhattan skyline beyond.

scenes.title: Corner Cafe
scenes.description: Cozy corner cafe: espresso bar with pastry case under a red awning, round tables with seated customers, window bench; a mug to bus and a pastry to deliver.

scenes.title: Roastery Cafe
scenes.description: Industrial roastery cafe: concrete floor, long communal tables with stools, exposed ducting, green awning and a roaster drum in the corner.

scenes.title: 5th Ave & Central Park
scenes.description: Fifth Avenue at the park: a leafy Central Park edge with a stone wall, path, trees and a pond on one side; grand limestone apartment houses on the other; joggers, dog-walkers and a hot-dog cart.

scenes.title: Factory Floor
scenes.description: Industrial hall with CNC machine, hydraulic press, pallets, shelving and a safety-striped robot cell; real tools on the workbench.

scenes.title: Fast Food
scenes.description: Burger joint: checkerboard floor, glowing menu boards over the order counter, soda fountain, red booths — trays and a burger box to clear.

scenes.title: Financial District
scenes.description: Downtown canyons: tall towers packed close on narrow streets, the Charging Bull, a columned exchange facade and the odd yellow cab. Deep shadow, big verticals.

scenes.title: Fine Dining
scenes.description: White-tablecloth dining room: clothed rounds with candles and place settings, high-back chairs, drapes, a grand piano — and a waiter circulating silently.

scenes.title: Front Yard
scenes.description: Suburban front yard: house facade with porch, lawn, driveway with a parked car, picket fence, flower beds, mailbox — and a kid's ball to fetch.

scenes.title: Golf Course
scenes.description: A 40 m par-3 hole: striped fairway to a raised green with pin and real golf balls, two sand bunkers, cart path with parked cart, tee boxes and tree lines.

scenes.title: Gym
scenes.description: Strength & cardio floor on speckled rubber: squat rack, benches, dumbbell rack, treadmills, plyo boxes and a mirror wall; kettlebell and dumbbells are real free bodies.

scenes.title: Home / Kitchen
scenes.description: Cozy home kitchen and dining room with a work island, counter, fridge and real graspable tableware.

scenes.title: Busy Intersection
scenes.description: A signalized four-way crossing: alternating N-S / E-W traffic with cars braking at the stop lines, pedestrians timed to the gaps, corner shops on every quadrant. The robot owns the SW corner.

scenes.title: Franka Kitchen
scenes.description: The classic D4RL Franka Kitchen benchmark: articulated oven, microwave, cabinets and a movable kettle, rescaled for MABEL.

scenes.title: LA Hills Suburb
scenes.description: A Los Angeles hillside neighbourhood: single-family houses with pitched roofs, driveways and lawns along a palm- and plum-lined street, brown hills rising behind with the HOLLYWOOD sign, and a dog trotting the block.

scenes.title: Living Room
scenes.description: Living room with sofa, coffee table, TV wall, bookshelf, rug and floor lamp; mug and speaker to pick up.

scenes.title: Family Living Room
scenes.description: Warm carpeted family room: two facing sofas, toy-strewn play rug, TV and bookshelf; foam blocks and a ball for pick-up practice.

scenes.title: Loft Living Room
scenes.description: Industrial loft: brick walls, wood floor, L-sofa around a slab coffee table, big TV, kitchenette bar with stools and a wall of glass; speaker and mug to fetch.

scenes.title: Manhattan Sidewalk
scenes.description: A Midtown block: the robot works a wide sidewalk between storefronts and a two-way street; taxis and cars circle the block, pedestrians stream both ways, lights and awnings overhead.

scenes.title: Manhattan — Midtown Grid
scenes.description: A giant Midtown Manhattan grid: three avenues, nine cross-streets, packed with glass towers, brownstones, art-deco skyscrapers and condos, with taxis and traffic streaming the avenues and crowds on the sidewalks. The robot works a corner plaza.

scenes.title: Office
scenes.description: Office with two desk pods, monitors, chairs, filing cabinets and a whiteboard; laptop, keyboard, mouse and mug on the desks.

scenes.title: Outdoor Park
scenes.description: Open grass field under a blue sky with a gravel path, trees, rocks and a park bench.

scenes.title: City Plaza
scenes.description: A pedestrian plaza around a fountain: crowds criss-crossing with pauses at the water, a coffee kiosk, benches, planters and pigeons — no cars, all people.

scenes.title: Restaurant
scenes.description: Casual bistro: wood four-tops with seated diners, wall banquette, service bar, pendant lights — and a waiter doing rounds between the tables.

scenes.title: Rooftop Lounge
scenes.description: Dusk rooftop bar: glowing pool, loungers and parasols, bar counter with stools, planters, string lights and a skyline of lit facades beyond the parapet.

scenes.title: Supermarket
scenes.description: Grocery store: three product aisles, produce tables with real fruit to pick, a glass cooler wall and two checkout lanes — with shoppers wandering the aisles.

scenes.title: Times Square
scenes.description: Times Square at the bowtie: buildings sheathed in glowing billboards where Broadway cuts the avenue grid, the red TKTS steps, dense crowds, yellow cabs and a police booth. Bright, loud, unmistakable.

scenes.title: Venice Beach
scenes.description: A California beach: soft sand down to a glittering ocean, a boardwalk lined with palms, a lifeguard tower and volleyball net, cars cruising the road behind. Sun, palms, surf.

scenes.title: Warehouse
scenes.description: Warehouse aisle between two tall pallet racks loaded with cardboard boxes; a bin and tools at picking height.

scenes.title: Washroom
scenes.description: Family bathroom in small white tile: double vanity with mirror, bathtub, glass shower stall and toilet; towels and a laundry basket within reach.
